label: 002050 三花智控 Full Research v1

factual_observations.statement: H1 core earnings and cash flow remained resilient.
Robot actuators entered batch-delivery/ramp language and liquid-cooling products already serve some global customers.

discovery.why_now: H1 plus new-business commercialization justify first Full Research; expectation envelope comes before probability.
discovery.current_market_expression: A 002050 / H 02050; one Belief, separate market Odds.
discovery.contradiction_or_mapping_warning: New-business commercialization is real but economics remain unquantified.
discovery.next_discriminating_search: Separate core earnings from optionality and company downside from market de-rating.
discovery.known_stop_or_downgrade_condition: No mass-scale robot/liquid-cooling profit in base without quantified economics.

pre_research.what_is_this: Global thermal-control component supplier with refrigeration/auto core and early liquid-cooling/robot businesses.
pre_research.why_surfaced_now: Robot status moved to batch delivery/ramp while core H1 stayed resilient.
pre_research.current_expression_or_leadership: A 002050 / H 02050; one Belief, separate market Odds.
pre_research.basic_business_role: Qualified valves, pumps, heat exchangers and control components for HVAC, vehicles and newer applications.
pre_research.potential_fundamental_driver: Core compounding plus measurable liquid-cooling/robot earnings.
pre_research.current_market_expectation_hypothesis: 2027 market center is near CNY5.5bn; mass-scale robot profit is not a base fact.

material_claims.statement: H1 revenue was about CNY16.9bn, deducted profit CNY2.15bn and OCF CNY2.50bn.

pre_research.obvious_contradiction: Refrigeration grew only ~0.5%; automotive ~9.9%; new-business economics were not separately quantified.
pre_research.largest_unknown: How much 2027-28 profit comes from core versus new businesses?
pre_research.next_discriminating_search: Retain market core, company downside and bounded right tail before probability.

quick_research.business_model: Scaled thermal-control franchise; mature earnings fund adjacent optionality.
quick_research.segment_mix: H1 is still overwhelmingly refrigeration + automotive.
quick_research.economic_role: Qualified component supplier where reliability, engineering and global manufacturing matter.
quick_research.current_industry_state: Core is mature-to-growing; liquid cooling is commercial; humanoid robots are early industrialization.
quick_research.market_expectation_hypothesis: Use the CNY5.3-5.8bn cluster as state-space center, not truth.
quick_research.current_expression_or_leadership: A 002050 / H 02050; one Belief, separate market Odds.

supporting_claims.statement: H1 refrigeration revenue was about CNY10.45bn; automotive about CNY6.46bn and +9.9%.
Robot actuators were progressing through batch delivery/ramp; liquid-cooling products had some global customer supply.

contradictory_claims.statement: Core growth is not hypergrowth and new-business economics remain unquantified.
CICC cut 2027 profit to CNY5.422bn for slower automotive growth; A/H 2027 PE context was about 28x/17x.

quick_research.evidence_authority_assessment: Filings own facts; IR owns commercialization status; sell-side owns expectation context only.
quick_research.variant_perception: Keep premium core quality, but do not capitalize unquantified robot TAM into base or duplicate market de-rating inside Fundamental Belief.
quick_research.route_reason: Probability needs a causal earnings bridge.

material_claims.statement: H1 operating cash flow was about CNY2.50bn while core segment growth stayed positive but moderate.
Robot/liquid-cooling evidence justifies explicit upside worlds, not mass-scale base earnings; broad-market de-rating belongs later in Participation/Odds.
Five 2027 worlds retain company downside, market-core states and a low-probability robot right tail.

explicit_falsifiers: Core refrigeration and automotive weaken together with margin/cash-conversion deterioration.
2027 company-specific earnings evidence falls materially below CNY5.0bn.
Robot batch delivery fails to convert into repeatable revenue/margin.
Liquid-cooling supply fails to become economically material.

adversarial_findings.question: Expectation envelope first?
adversarial_findings.finding: Yes; 2027 market range is reconstructed before probability.

adversarial_findings.question: Robot TAM in base?
adversarial_findings.finding: No; unquantified optionality sits only in higher worlds.

adversarial_findings.question: Market weakness double-counted?
adversarial_findings.finding: No; Fundamental multiples exclude broad-market regime.

evidence_artifacts.source_location: post-H1 forecast envelope plus CICC revision context

extracted_structured_values.state: primary/secondary-side products supplied to some global customers

research_snapshot.core_thesis: 核心热管理提供盈利底盘；液冷已有客户供货，机器人执行器进入批量交付/产线爬坡，右尾不能删除；但独立收入、利润率和客户allocation尚未量化，不能劫持2027中心盈利。Fundamental Belief不吸收大盘弱势，market regime留给Participation/Odds。
research_snapshot.market_expectations_narrative: 20家机构2027净利约50.99-58.07亿元、均值55.13亿元；H1后主要更新约52.56-57.74亿元。研报定义expectation envelope，不定义未来概率。
research_snapshot.model_risk_notes: 成熟核心降低模型风险，但汽车增速、液冷放量、机器人unit economics和终值倍数仍高度不确定。
thesis_invalidation: Core refrigeration and automotive weaken together with margin/cash-conversion deterioration.
2027 company-specific earnings evidence falls materially below CNY5.0bn.
Robot batch delivery fails to convert into repeatable revenue/margin.
Liquid-cooling supply fails to become economically material.
